name: Mini-Diffusion Meme
summary: A 3x3 grid of small, smudged images that answer a silly text prompt, with warped faces and soft shapes. It went viral in 2022 from a free, low-resolution image model.

philosophy.core_thesis: The joke is the gap between a plain prompt and a soft, wrong picture; the smudge is the format.
design_principles: Arrange 9 images in a 3x3 grid of 256px tiles with a 4px gap and no gutter.
Let each tile show a blur of 1px to 2px and a visible JPEG block pattern at 8px blocks.
Warp one feature in each image: a face, a hand or a sign with false letters.
Put the prompt as the caption above the grid in 20px mono, in lower case, inside quotation marks.
Set a 1px dark frame around the grid and a plain cream ground (#F4EFE6).
Use a colour range of muddy brown, green and a pale sky; avoid pure white and pure black in tiles.
Show a small orange button, such as Run, below the grid at 40px height.

layout.grid_mechanics: One 3x3 grid of 256px tiles with 4px gaps (776px wide), the prompt above and one button below.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 30% to 40% of the page stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 16 and 32px.
layout.alignment_rules: The grid is centred; the prompt aligns flush-left to the grid edge.
layout.container_geometry: Square tiles with a 0px radius; a pill button with a 4px radius.

font_pairings.note: A mono prompt line over a neutral text face.
A quirky mono face for the caption.

hierarchy_rules: Set the prompt in lower case with quotation marks.
Keep the page title to one line.

color.palette_structure: Muddy neutrals on a cream page, with one orange for the action.
color.contrast_rules: Black text on cream holds at least 15:1; orange is for the button with dark text at 5:1 or more.
color.surface_treatment: Flat cream page; tiles show soft, low-detail images with visible 8px JPEG blocks.
color.light_and_shadow: No shadow on the page; the tiles have flat, flattened light with no clear source.

materiality.surface_simulation: A compressed, low-resolution output: small images, scaled up and blocky.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px frame in #1E1E1E around the grid; tiles have no border.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A 1px to 2px blur inside tiles; the page has no elevation.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid icons at 20px with square corners for run and save.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Smudged scenes: a face with extra teeth, a landmark that melts, a sign with false letters.

motion.transition_physics: The grid fills with a loading bar of 30 to 60 seconds, then the tiles appear at once; no motion after.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover darkens the button by 10%; active shifts it down 1px.

emotion.target_response: The viewer laughs at a wrong, soft picture and trusts the joke more than the image.

use_cases: posts about early AI image tools
avoid_when: The page needs a polished, trustworthy brand image.
The images must be exact or accurate.
The audience reads the faults as insult.

modifiers.how: Replace the grid with one smooth 1024px render and add a rim light.
Use one tile only and add a deadpan caption in plain type.
Show one clean, centred headshot with the eye line at 40%.

pack.why: A square, pixel family suits the blocky, low-resolution output of the format.

ground.why: The ground is a plain cream page, like a simple web form that holds a prompt box.
